notes.title: Beta Release №2
notes.content: We have significantly reworked the game, simplified and improved a lot. If earlier it was not clear what to do - now the concept is simple - to find a way out of the maze! Run on the smoke from the fire and don't die on the way. If you like, we will add additional difficulties of survival, but for now check out our prototype.

notes.title: Game rework
notes.content: We have significantly reworked the game and will be updated in a month. Until then, you can play the old version one last time for just $ 1.
